plan.title: Consolidate CLI scripts into single dispatcher
plan.overview: Refactor 24 individual TypeScript CLI scripts into a unified dispatcher architecture following the DAG pattern: computers (pure logic) → capabilities (I/O) → orchestrator (routing). The single entry point `festinalente.cjs` will use a command registry to route arguments to handlers, with shared utilities for argument parsing, file operations, and search functionality. This eliminates the 886-character build:scripts command and makes adding new commands trivial.

approach.rationale:
Following established patterns from the VSCode extension: - Orchestrator pattern at apps/vscode/src/extension.ts for command routing - Factory-DI pattern at .festinalente/engineering/patterns/factory-di.md:35-39 for testability - Capability-Computer separation at .festinalente/engineering/patterns/capability-computer.md:36-49 - Tagged-union errors at .festinalente/engineering/patterns/tagged-union-errors.md:35-49 for consistent JSON output
The CLI orchestrator will be thin (~100 lines) - it routes commands to domain handlers. Each handler category (task, search, validation, config, docs, query, quick, spec) becomes a separate handler module. Computers contain pure logic (parsing, search algorithms); Capabilities wrap I/O (fs, git).

task.name: Create computers for pure logic
task.action:
- Create xml-parser.computer.ts: - Migrate logic from src/scripts/lib/xml-parser.ts - createXmlParserComputer factory returning parseTaskXml, parseSpecXml, parsePlanXml - Use fast-xml-parser (already a dependency)
- Create yaml-parser.computer.ts: - createYamlParserComputer factory returning parseFrontmatter, parseYaml - Use gray-matter and js-yaml (already dependencies)
- Create search.computer.ts: - Consolidate duplicate search logic from search-product.ts, search-engineering.ts, search-hybrid.ts - createSearchComputer factory returning: - createSearchIndex(items, keys) - search(query, options) - scoreResults(results) - Use fuse.js (already a dependency)
- Create validation.computer.ts: - createValidationComputer factory returning: - validateTaskXml(content) - validateYamlFrontmatter(content) - validateDirective(content)
All computers must: - Have no fs/path imports (pure functions only) - Use factory-DI pattern - Return explicit types - Have TSDoc on exports
task.done: All computers compile, no I/O imports present

task.name: Create capabilities for I/O operations
task.action:
- Create file-system.capability.ts: - createFileSystemCapability factory returning: - readFile(path): Result<string, Error> - writeFile(path, content): Result<void, Error> - exists(path): boolean - readDir(path): Result<string[], Error> - listDirectories(path): Result<string[], Error> - joinPath(...parts): string - All methods return Result types for error handling - Wrap fs operations in try/catch
- Create git.capability.ts: - createGitCapability factory returning: - getLastCommitDate(filePath): Result<Date, Error> - getCurrentBranch(): Result<string, Error> - Use child_process.execFile (NOT execSync) to prevent command injection - Current check-freshness.ts:79-82 uses execSync - fix this security issue
Current vulnerable code in check-freshness.ts: ```typescript // VULNERABLE - uses execSync with string interpolation const gitLog = execSync(`git log -1 --format=%ci -- "${file}"`, { encoding: 'utf8' }); ```
Change to: ```typescript // SAFE - uses execFile with array arguments const { stdout } = await execFileAsync('git', ['log', '-1', '--format=%ci', '--', file]); ```
task.done: Capabilities compile, execFile used instead of execSync

edge-cases.case: Command names must be unique across all handlers; registry should reject duplicates at registration time
Each handler validates required args with zod; missing args return descriptive error message
Command names are validated against alphanumeric + hyphen pattern
Args passed as array, no length limit imposed; individual handlers may validate

pitfalls.pitfall: Use execFile with argument array, never string interpolation with user input
Each handler must return exact same JSON structure as original script - compare output during migration
Verify all 24 commands are registered in orchestrator; use type-safe registry that errors on duplicate names
Add zod to noExternal in tsdown config to ensure it's bundled with dispatcher
Use inventory sets to track all files; verify each file updated before deleting old scripts
